title: Topic Brief
description: Stage 1 output of the business-documentary pipeline. Locks the working angle BEFORE any research or claim exists, so no downstream stage can quietly redefine the subject.

working_title.description: Working title only. The publish title is written at the publish stage.

niche.description: The hidden-business domain, e.g. 'commercial laundry services'.

unique_question.description: The ONE question the film answers. Must name an economic mechanism.

target_duration_seconds.description: 60-90 for the E2E pilot; 360-600 for editorial pilots.

why_it_works.description: Reasons the topic earns a film: mechanism, stakes, surprise, scale.

primary_source_expectations.description: Source classes the angle NEEDS before it can be told (filings, regulators, court records, patents...).

constraints.description: Binding constraints for the run. Must include the strict zero-cost mode statement.
